transcript: Speaker A: Ek baat puchu, English se darr lagta hai ya logo ke saamne galat bolne se? Mujhe lagta hai doosra wala zyada hota hai. Isliye mujhe SpeakEasy app achha lagta hai. Wahan Vaani AI hai, jo kabhi mazaak nahi udaati, kabhi judge nahi karti, bas patiently English practice karwati rehti hai. Chahe interview ho, office presentation ho, ya daily conversation. Vaani har situation ki practice karwa sakti hai. Roz sirf 15 minute aur dheere dheere confidence build hone lagta hai. Sirf ek rupaye ka trial hai, toh excuses mat banao. [Can I ask you something, are you afraid of English or of speaking it incorrectly in front of people? I think it's the latter. That's why I like the SpeakEasy app. There is Vaani AI, who never makes fun of you, never judges, just patiently helps you practice English. Whether it's an interview, office presentation, or daily conversation, Vaani can help you practice every situation. Just 15 minutes daily and slowly your confidence starts building. There is a trial for just one rupee, so don't make excuses.] Speaker B: Abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
